question.text: An issuer plans an IPO of Rs. 500 crore. What is the minimum security deposit amount that must be placed with the designated stock exchange before the issue opens?

explanation.text: The Logic: Before opening the subscription list, the issuer must deposit 1% of the public issue size with the designated stock exchange. For an issue of Rs. 500 crore: 1% x Rs. 500 crore = Rs. 5 crore. The Trap: Rs. 2.5 crore represents 0.5% (half the actual rate) and Rs. 10 crore represents 2%, both of which are common calculation errors against the prescribed 1%. Note: The deposit is computed on the public issue size and is treated (refundable or forfeitable) in the manner specified by SEBI or the stock exchanges.
